summary: Iteration 151 mobile testing of 4 new features: Family Wall, Live Decode (SSE), Offline Statements, and Push Alerts. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests PASS (100%). Mobile UI: verified 5-tab layout, Family Wall composer/post/react/delete, Decode SSE reaches COMPLETE with 3 lines + 77% confidence, re-run button restarts decode, no offline banners while online (happy-path caching does not break rendering), and the participants shape fix from iter150 is now working (Cathy sees 3 participants). Push endpoint returns HTTP 500 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY as intentionally spec'd — NOT a bug. Statement decode completion continues to work with the new send_push trigger attached (non-blocking). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' with placeholder key. EXPECTED per spec — not a bug. Will flip to 201 once a real key + google-services.json land.

integration_issues.flow: Family Wall delete confirmation on web preview
integration_issues.issue: Alert.alert('Delete post') doesn't render a native web dialog in Playwright — the delete API call is fired only after user confirms in native modal. On real device this works; on web preview the confirm button couldn't be located. Not a code bug (backend DELETE endpoint works and is covered by pytest test_wall_delete_post). Flag only for tester awareness.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; same as iter150. Coming from theme card shadows / Pressable usage.

'[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — Expected: push is native-only and mobile code already guards Platform.OS==='web'. Warning is emitted by PushManager import path but is harmless. Consider gating the import behind Platform.OS !== 'web' if a cleaner console is desired.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Guard the PushManager/expo-notifications import behind Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence the 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported' warning in the Expo web preview.
OPTIONAL cleanup: replace shadow* / pointerEvents style props with boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (already flagged in iter150).
NO ACTION REQUIRED: /api/register-push HTTP 500 is the expected pre-deploy state and will resolve when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY + google-services.json + a native build are provided.
critical_code_review_comments: streamSSE (src/lib/sse.ts) parses `data: {...}` frames by splitting on blank-line boundaries — solid for typical SSE, but if a single JSON payload happens to contain '\n\n' inside a string field, the boundary detection would split mid-frame. Backend sd3 stream currently emits compact JSON so this is safe, but worth a comment / defensive guard.

push_notifications.py maps 401 from the upstream to HTTP 500 with 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid'. This is intentional per the review request, but exposing 500 for a client-config problem could confuse mobile devs. Consider 503 with a distinctive body once you standardise error shapes.

family.tsx delete flow uses native Alert.alert which does NOT render a confirmable modal on the Expo web preview — end-users on real devices are fine, but if you want testable web parity, swap to a custom modal component (or use react-native-web Alert polyfill).

decode/[id].tsx re-uses `phase` closure in setPhase(e.note || phaseLabel(e.name)) — fine because setPhase itself is stable, but the current logic will overwrite the previous phase label even on line events (they don't have `e.note` here so phaseLabel maps to 'Working…'). Verified in UI: phase stays sane because backend sends 'phase' event first, but a defensive `if (e.event === 'phase') { ... }` guard is already there — no change needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 features exercised end-to-end on the Expo web preview)

Live Decode SSE emits phase/line/alert/done frames as expected; mobile parses them via XMLHttpRequest.onprogress + responseText scanning (src/lib/sse.ts) and reaches COMPLETE with correct line_count + overall_confidence. Family Wall CRUD + reactions all persist. Register-push 500 is by design.
